["m", "verdify", false, false, null, [], " SELECT public.time_bucket('00:30:00'::interval, ts) AS bucket,
    avg(temp_avg) FILTER (WHERE temp_avg IS NOT NULL) AS temp_avg,
    avg(temp_north) FILTER (WHERE temp_north IS NOT NULL) AS temp_north,
    avg(temp_south) FILTER (WHERE temp_south IS NOT NULL) AS temp_south,
    avg(rh_avg) FILTER (WHERE rh_avg IS NOT NULL) AS rh_avg,
    avg(vpd_avg) FILTER (WHERE vpd_avg IS NOT NULL) AS vpd_avg,
    avg(co2_ppm) FILTER (WHERE co2_ppm IS NOT NULL) AS co2_ppm,
    avg(lux) FILTER (WHERE lux IS NOT NULL) AS lux,
    max(dli_today) FILTER (WHERE dli_today IS NOT NULL) AS dli_today,
    avg(outdoor_temp_f) FILTER (WHERE outdoor_temp_f IS NOT NULL) AS outdoor_temp_f,
    avg(outdoor_rh_pct) FILTER (WHERE outdoor_rh_pct IS NOT NULL) AS outdoor_rh_pct,
    avg(solar_irradiance_w_m2) FILTER (WHERE solar_irradiance_w_m2 IS NOT NULL) AS solar_w_m2,
    avg(solar_altitude_deg) FILTER (WHERE solar_altitude_deg IS NOT NULL) AS solar_alt,
    avg(solar_azimuth_deg) FILTER (WHERE solar_azimuth_deg IS NOT NULL) AS solar_az,
    avg(wind_speed_mph) FILTER (WHERE wind_speed_mph IS NOT NULL) AS wind_mph,
    avg(pressure_hpa) FILTER (WHERE pressure_hpa IS NOT NULL) AS pressure_hpa,
    avg(outdoor_lux) FILTER (WHERE outdoor_lux IS NOT NULL) AS outdoor_lux,
    avg(flow_gpm) FILTER (WHERE flow_gpm IS NOT NULL) AS flow_gpm,
    avg(enthalpy_delta) FILTER (WHERE enthalpy_delta IS NOT NULL) AS enthalpy_delta
   FROM public.climate
  GROUP BY (public.time_bucket('00:30:00'::interval, ts));"]

["v", "verdify", false, false, null, [], " SELECT 'sensor_health'::text AS component,
    round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT v_sensor_staleness.is_stale)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0)::numeric, 1) AS score_pct,
    jsonb_build_object('total_sensors', count(*), 'healthy', count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT v_sensor_staleness.is_stale), 'stale', count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_sensor_staleness.is_stale)) AS details,
    now() AS checked_at
   FROM public.v_sensor_staleness
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'alert_load'::text AS component,
    GREATEST(0::numeric, round(100.0 - COALESCE(sum(
        CASE alert_log.severity
            WHEN 'critical'::text THEN 10
            WHEN 'warning'::text THEN 3
            WHEN 'info'::text THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END), 0::bigint)::numeric, 1)) AS score_pct,
    jsonb_build_object('open_total', count(*), 'critical', count(*) FILTER (WHERE alert_log.severity = 'critical'::text), 'warning', count(*) FILTER (WHERE alert_log.severity = 'warning'::text)) AS details,
    now() AS checked_at
   FROM public.alert_log
  WHERE alert_log.disposition = 'open'::text
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'equipment_health'::text AS component,
    public.fn_equipment_health()::numeric AS score_pct,
    jsonb_build_object('score', public.fn_equipment_health()) AS details,
    now() AS checked_at
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'controller'::text AS component,
    round(
        CASE
            WHEN d.ts IS NULL THEN 0::double precision
            ELSE LEAST(100::double precision, GREATEST(0::numeric, 40::numeric - EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - d.ts) / 15.0)::double precision + LEAST(30::double precision, GREATEST(0::double precision, (d.wifi_rssi + 80::double precision) * 1.0::double precision)) + LEAST(30::double precision, d.uptime_s / 120.0::double precision))
        END::numeric, 1) AS score_pct,
    jsonb_build_object('wifi_rssi_dbm', d.wifi_rssi, 'uptime_s', d.uptime_s, 'heap_bytes', d.heap_bytes) AS details,
    now() AS checked_at
   FROM ( SELECT diagnostics.ts,
            diagnostics.wifi_rssi,
            diagnostics.uptime_s,
            diagnostics.heap_bytes
           FROM public.diagnostics
          WHERE diagnostics.ts > (now() - '00:10:00'::interval)
          ORDER BY diagnostics.ts DESC
         LIMIT 1) d;"]

relation|public.v_climate_merged|kind=m|owner=verdify|rls=f:f|acl=|effective=f:f:f:f:f:f:f|columns=1:bucket:timestamp with time zone:f::::|2:temp_avg:double precision:f::::|3:temp_north:double precision:f::::|4:temp_south:double precision:f::::|5:rh_avg:double precision:f::::|6:vpd_avg:double precision:f::::|7:co2_ppm:double precision:f::::|8:lux:double precision:f::::|9:dli_today:double precision:f::::|10:outdoor_temp_f:double precision:f::::|11:outdoor_rh_pct:double precision:f::::|12:solar_w_m2:double precision:f::::|13:solar_alt:double precision:f::::|14:solar_az:double precision:f::::|15:wind_mph:double precision:f::::|16:pressure_hpa:double precision:f::::|17:outdoor_lux:double precision:f::::|18:flow_gpm:double precision:f::::|19:enthalpy_delta:double precision:f::::|view= SELECT public.time_bucket('00:30:00'::interval, ts) AS bucket,

    avg(solar_altitude_deg) FILTER (WHERE solar_altitude_deg IS NOT NULL) AS solar_alt,
    avg(solar_azimuth_deg) FILTER (WHERE solar_azimuth_deg IS NOT NULL) AS solar_az,
    avg(wind_speed_mph) FILTER (WHERE wind_speed_mph IS NOT NULL) AS wind_mph,
    avg(pressure_hpa) FILTER (WHERE pressure_hpa IS NOT NULL) AS pressure_hpa,
    avg(outdoor_lux) FILTER (WHERE outdoor_lux IS NOT NULL) AS outdoor_lux,
    avg(flow_gpm) FILTER (WHERE flow_gpm IS NOT NULL) AS flow_gpm,

relation|public.v_system_health_score|kind=v|owner=verdify|rls=f:f|acl=|effective=f:f:f:f:f:f:f|columns=1:component:text:f::::16417:SELECT:f|2:score_pct:numeric:f::::16417:SELECT:f|3:details:jsonb:f::::|4:checked_at:timestamp with time zone:f::::|view= SELECT 'sensor_health'::text AS component,
    round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT v_sensor_staleness.is_stale)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0)::numeric, 1) AS score_pct,
    jsonb_build_object('total_sensors', count(*), 'healthy', count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT v_sensor_staleness.is_stale), 'stale', count(*) FILTER (WHERE v_sensor_staleness.is_stale)) AS details,
    now() AS checked_at
   FROM public.v_sensor_staleness
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'alert_load'::text AS component,
    GREATEST(0::numeric, round(100.0 - COALESCE(sum(
        CASE alert_log.severity
            WHEN 'critical'::text THEN 10
            WHEN 'warning'::text THEN 3
            WHEN 'info'::text THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END), 0::bigint)::numeric, 1)) AS score_pct,
    jsonb_build_object('open_total', count(*), 'critical', count(*) FILTER (WHERE alert_log.severity = 'critical'::text), 'warning', count(*) FILTER (WHERE alert_log.severity = 'warning'::text)) AS details,
    now() AS checked_at
   FROM public.alert_log
  WHERE alert_log.disposition = 'open'::text
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'equipment_health'::text AS component,
    public.fn_equipment_health()::numeric AS score_pct,
    jsonb_build_object('score', public.fn_equipment_health()) AS details,
    now() AS checked_at
UNION ALL
 SELECT 'controller'::text AS component,
    round(
        CASE
            WHEN d.ts IS NULL THEN 0::double precision
            ELSE LEAST(100::double precision, GREATEST(0::numeric, 40::numeric - EXTRACT(epoch FROM now() - d.ts) / 15.0)::double precision + LEAST(30::double precision, GREATEST(0::double precision, (d.wifi_rssi + 80::double precision) * 1.0::double precision)) + LEAST(30::double precision, d.uptime_s / 120.0::double precision))
        END::numeric, 1) AS score_pct,
    jsonb_build_object('wifi_rssi_dbm', d.wifi_rssi, 'uptime_s', d.uptime_s, 'heap_bytes', d.heap_bytes) AS details,
    now() AS checked_at
   FROM ( SELECT diagnostics.ts,
            diagnostics.wifi_rssi,
            diagnostics.uptime_s,
            diagnostics.heap_bytes
           FROM public.diagnostics
          WHERE diagnostics.ts > (now() - '00:10:00'::interval)
          ORDER BY diagnostics.ts DESC
         LIMIT 1) d;|constraints=|options=|rules=|triggers=|policies=
